Commentary.Commentary: Once Karthik fell, India lost the momentum and the Men from the Caribbean bounced back handsomely, picking 4 wickets for 13 runs. Rishabh Pant also scored 38 but looked to be struggling a lot in the middle. Jerome Taylor was the pick of the bowlers with 2/31 in his 4 overs. Kesrick Williams and Marlon Samuels were the others with wickets but proved expensive. The pitch looks good to bat on and the home side possess the firepower to chase this down. However it's going to be interesting against the Indian spinners. Chase coming up shortly!

Good comeback from West Indies, sees them restrcit India below 200. After being put into bat, India were off to a flier. Their two openers, Virat Kohli and Shikhar Dhawan took the West Indian bowling apart and pushed the hosts onto the back foot. However, both the batsmen got out in the same over. Dinesh Karthik took his time to set in but then went berserk, scoring 48 off just 29 balls.

FOUR! Good finish this, for India! Another low full toss, Ashwin drills it down the ground. The long on fielder can't cut it off and a boundary results. 18 runs off the last over and INDIA FINISH ON 190/6!
Very slow delivery, just at 95 kph. Ashwin punches it through covers and collects a brace.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Four Leg Byes! Pitched around leg, Jadeja opens up his stance, swings his bat but misses. The ball goes off the pads fine down the leg side to the fence. Williams appeals but umpire signals four leg byes.
SIX! Finally Jadeja nails one! Full and outside off, he gets down on one knee and slogs it. Connects it and gets it over mid-wicket for a biggie. Valuable runs, these!
Slower one, pushed through mid off for a single.
Low full toss, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, RJ drags it off the toe end to long on for a single. Jadeja calls for the second but Ashwin is not interested.
Ashwin bends his knees and bunts the low full toss to long on for a single.
Jadeja backs away and looks to flay the back of a length delivery on the off side. Gets an outside edge towards third man for a single.
Almost a yorker around off, jammed to third man for a single.

Two Wides! Jadeja makes some room. Taylor tries following him but overdoes it. Gets it way down the leg side. Even Walton can't stop it, however he gets a hand to it, taking off the pace. Wide is signalled and a bonus run is also taken.
Full toss around leg, worked to deep square leg for a single.
Ravichandran Ashwin strides out to the middle.

OUT! Good catch from Sunil Narine! Back of a length delivery, angling in, Jadhav goes for a half-pull. Fails to hit it cleanly and the ball skies in the air over square leg. Narine in the deep runs forward and to his left. Dives and completes a good catch. West Indies are chipping at wicket at regular intervals now. India have lost 4 wickets for 13 runs!
Shortish delivery around leg, Jadeja mistimes his pull in the mid on region for a single.
Another slower delivery by Williams, punched to long off for a single. This guy has some good slower deliveries up his sleeve.
Slower delivery, worked behind square leg for a single.
Shortish delivery, chopped towards Gayle at backward point for a single.
Slower delivery, cut to the left of deep cover for a brace.
Kesrick Williams is back for a bowl.
Jadeja flicks it on the leg side and with his quickness between the wickets, picks up a brace. Manages to deny Taylor the hat-trick.
Ravindra Jadeja walks out to face the hat-trick ball from Jerome Taylor.

OUT! Two-in-two! Taylor once again bowls it on a back of a length around off from around the wicket. Pant who backs away, gets cramped for room. Rishabh tries to ramp it over the keeper's head but edges it to Walton, who doesn't make any mistake. Pant's struggling knock comes to an end. Taylor on a hat-trick now! Good comeback this, from the hosts.
Kedar Jadhav is the next man in.

OUT! Dhoni departs! Back of a length delivery outside off. Dhoni looks to drag it from outside off with a horizontal bat but gets a top edge. The ball lobs in the air and Samuels at backward point takes a couple of steps behind and gobbles the catch. No Dhoni finish today. These wickets will prove very crucial!
Very full around middle and off, Pant carves it to backward point. Dhoni from the other end takes off for a quick single and completes it as the throw at his end misses the stumps.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Fortunate Pant! Back of a length delivery, angling across, Pant dances down and looks to slash it over on the off side but the bat turns in his hand and his top hand comes off as well. Gets it to deep covers and a single is taken. The replay shows that the bat had completely come off Rishabh's hand and it fell just in front of the stumps.
Pant once again looks to go hard and ends up mistiming again. This time to long on for a single.
Dhoni gets off the mark with a flick through the leg side for a single.
MS Dhoni walks out to the middle.

OUT! Timber! The shuffling in the end gets the better of Dinesh Karthik! Samuels expecting Dinesh to shimmy, fires it into the stumps. The Indian batsman does so as expected but misses his sweep this time and sees his stumps shattered. Karthik misses out his half century by two runs. Nonetheless, it was a good knock from him.
Seeing Pant give the charge, Marlon fires it at 103 kph on the shorter side. The southpaw still manages to hammer it to long on for a single.
FOUR! This time through the off side. Samuels fires it, slanting it away from the southpaw. Pant stands tall and slashes it over extra cover for a boundary. 10 runs off the first two balls.

SIX! This will boost Pant's confidence! Slightly slower through the air around middle, Rishabh goes back and hammers it over mid-wicket. The ball sails with the wind over the man in the deep for a maximum.
Full on middle and off, Rishabh once again fails to get his timing right. Mistimes his drill to long on for a single.
Slower delivery outside off, guided with deft touch past the keeper. The third man fielder is there and so only a single is taken.

Another short delivery. Taylor making all his experience count and testing the Indian youngster with it. Pant once again mistimes his pull and is lucky that it goes on the bounce to deep mid-wicket fielder. A single is taken.

The physio is out in the middle to treat Rishabh Pant who is holding his shoulder in pain. Meanwhile, Pollard and Brathwaite are having a talk with Taylor. Hope Pant is fine and he can continue batting.

Ouch! Pant looks in pain! Short delivery, Rishabh looks to pull but once again fails to get his timing right. Is a bit early and gets rapped on the right shoulder. The ball lobs on the leg side and the keeper runs to it. Karthik who is backing up a long way, sees Pant down in pain and has to sprint back to his crease and gets in till the throw reaches the bowler.
Very full on middle, dug out through mid on for a single.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Jerome Taylor is back for a bowl.
FOUR! Lucky! Karthik gets a long way across to sweep it over on the leg side. Gets a top edge and the ball flies over the keeper's head. Past the short third man fielder and to the fence behind.

Just short! Spinning away from around middle and off, Pant goes back and has a go at it. Fails to connect it cleanly. The ball lobs over mid off. Powell from the deep runs forward, dives ahead too but fails to get to the ball. A single is taken. Pant needs to relax a bit.
Slanting across Pant, he looks to slog it across on the leg side but misses.
Karthik dances down and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pant steps down a touch and bunts it to long off for a single.
Spinning away from the southpaw, punched to extra cover.
Change of ends for Marlon Samuels.
SIX! Perfect end to the over! Another back of a length delivery, angling in, Karthik gets across and pulls it onto the roof of the mid-wicket stands. He is on fire!

Run out chance missed! Shortish outside off, Karthik chops it to backward point. The fielder there throws it towards his bowler seeing Pant come a long way ahead from the non-striker's end. But, by the time the throw comes, Rishabh is safely in.

Back of a length delivery outside off, Dinesh walks forward and across but gets beaten by the extra bounce there. The keeper spots Karthik out of his crease and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. The Indian batsman was slightly casual but he made sure he was safe.
Wide! Full but down the leg side. Karthik fails to flick it away.

SIX! Goodness gracious me! Karthik predetermines to go after Brathwaite. Gets across and pulls the back of a length delivery from outside off over long leg for a maximum. This is some execution from DK!
Back of a length delivery outside off, Karthik looks to dab it on the off side but misses.
50-run stand between Rishabh Pant and Dinesh Karthik!
Shortish delivery outside off, Pant looks to pull it away but mistimes it in the wide mid on region for a single.
Carlos Brathwaite brings himself back into the attack.

FOUR! Cut away! Slightly shorter outside off, Karthik makes room and cuts it through the backward point region for a boundary. This is good for India. They have started to score boundary every over again now.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Pant makes room to cut but is beaten by some extra bounce there.
Served around off, spinning in. Karthik prods forward to defend but is beaten. Gets it off the glove through his legs on the leg side. A single is taken.
Pant mistimes his cut on the off side and gets a single.
Served around off, spinning away, Pant smashes it through covers for a couple.

FOUR! Well-adjusted! Seeing Karthik get across, Samuels fires it flatter around middle. Dinesh is already in the position to play a slog sweep, gets surprised but adjusts well and delicately guides it fine down the leg side. Another boundary is conceded and the Samuels experiment has not worked for West Indies.
SIX! Fetch that, says Karthik! Off spinner around off, Karthik gets into the position early. Kneels down and slog sweeps it handsomely over mid-wicket for a maximum. He is getting a move on now.
Another shortish delivery around leg, Pant mistimes his pull through square leg for a single.
Slightly shorter this time, punched to covers. The fielder there fumbles a touch but doesn't concede a single.
Served fuller around off, spinning away, played towards point.
Served outside off, spinning in. Worked off the back foot through wide mid on. Karthik looks for a second but Pant is content with a single.
Marlon Samuels to bowl next.
Eased towards mid on for a single.
Again wide outside off, Karthik cuts again but finds the fielder at point.
Short and wide outside off, Karthik cuts it towards the fielder at point.
FOUR! Good shot, Karthik! Around middle and off, Dinesh kneels down and sweeps it through the square leg region for a boundary. Conventional strokeplay works for him.
Shortish around middle and leg, Karthik goes to play the scoop but fails to make contact. The ball goes just over the stumps.
Short and around off, slapped towards sweeper cover for a single.
Short into the pads, nudged through backward square leg for a single.
Short in line of the stumps, Dinesh camps back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Punched through covers for a single.

FOUR! Short around leg, Pant stays deep in his crease and pulls it through the mid-wicket region. Lewis puts in a dive in the deep to save the boundary but it isn't a good effort and concedes a boundary.
Fuller into the pads, Karthik clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Quicker around off, Pant chops it towards short third man for a single.
Fuller into the pads, Karthik clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Short and wide outside off, slashed through point for a single.
Tossed outside off, Karthik goes for the reverse sweep. Gets it past the slip fielder for a single.
FOUR! Gets his first boundary! Just outside off, Karthik stays in his crease and cuts it really late through the backward point region for a boundary.
Floated outside off, Karthik gets forward and defends it on the off side.
Short around leg, Pant stays in his crease and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Sunil Narine is brought into the attack.
Outside off, Karthik prods forward in defence. Gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Two leg byes! Bowls a wrong 'un around middle and leg, Karthik prods forward. Fails to get his bat to it, goes off the pads through the short fine leg region for a couple of leg byes.
Short and wide outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Karthik drives it through covers for a single.
Floated outside off, Pant glides it towards short third man for a single.
Quicker around off, nudged towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Samuel Badree is back on.
Slower delivery outside off, pushed towards mid off for a quick single.
The West Indies have got rid of both the openers and have bounced back in some fashion. DINESH KARTHIK is the new man in.

OUT! Mix up there in the middle and Dhawan has to make the long walk back! Short delivery outside off, Pant defends it on the leg side and makes an initial stride forward for a run. Seeing Williams closing onto the ball, sends Dhawan back who is halfway down the track. Williams collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Shikhar cannot do anything except walking back to the dressing room. Two crucial wickets for West Indies in quick succession.
Short delivery angling across, Dhawan pulls it through square leg for a single.
RISHABH PANT walks out in the middle. The openers have laid the platform and taken a major burden off the young man's shoulders.

OUT! One too many! Bowls a slower one outside off on a length, Kohli stays in his crease and tries to loft it over mid on. Fails to time it this time and the ball lobs towards Sunil Narine, who pouches it safely. Williams celebrates by ticking Kohli's wicket off his bucket list. West Indies have got a much-needed breakthrough.
FOUR! Another back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli smashes that over the backward point region for a boundary.

SIX! What was that? Back of a length, Kohli stays in his crease, does not move an inch and just lofts it with the perfect timing. Gets the distance on it and the ball flies over the long on boundary for a maximum.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli defends it on the leg side for a quick single.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli charges down the track and tries to go hard over the cover region but he fails to make contact.
Wide! The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Wide! Spilled down the leg side, Kohli fails to clip it through.
FOUR! Good length delivery around off, Kohli goes a bit leg side, makes room and punches it through covers for a boundary. India reaches the 50-run mark, the fastest against West Indies.
Play and a miss! A rare sight today. Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli tries to run it down late but fails to make contact.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Dhawan runs it down towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Dhawan welcomes Braithwaite with a boundary! Short outside off, Dhawan cuts it powerfully over the backward point region for a boundary.
Skipper Carlos Brathwaite brings himself into the attack. Can he stop this Indian assault?
Angling into the pads, Dhawan flicks it through the square leg region for a single. Another costly over, 10 runs off it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, steered towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Brilliant! Short delivery again and Kohli is ready for it. Stays in his crease and pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
FOUR! Another short delivery outside off, Kohli stands tall to it and goes for the slap over mid off. Doesn't get it off the middle but clears the fielder there and the ball races away to the fence.
Kohli camps back and taps it towards the fielder at cover-point.
Starts with a delivery short and wide outside off, Kohli tries to smash it over the backward point region but he fails to make contact. Lucky for Williams, as it was really close to the wide line.
Kesrick Williams comes on, replacing Taylor.
Fuller around off, Dhawan defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Another wrong 'un and another boundary for India! Badree tosses up a googly outside off, Dhawan goes hard at it, gets a thick outside edge past Gayle at short third man for a boundary.
Outside off, Dhawan cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Kohli clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Kohli gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Quicker through the air outside off, Kohli tries to cut but fails to make contact.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side, Kohli went for the sweep but he failed to make contact. A wide is signaled.

FOUR! That was creamed! On a length outside off, Dhawan just leans into it and drives it crisply through covers for a boundary. There is no stopping that. Another brilliant over for India. 13 runs off it as well.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli dabs it towards the fielder at third man for a single.
Length delivery around middle and off, Kohli lunges forward in defence.
Back of a length delivery around off, Kohli defends it back to the bowler.
Virat Kohli now becomes the highest run-scorer for India in T20Is. He also has the highest average in T20Is amongst everyone in the world (minimum 500 runs scored).
FOUR! Easy pickings! Angling into the batsman, Kohli just leans a bit forward and flicks it beautifully through front of square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Another poor delivery! Taylor too strays on the pads, Kohli camps back and works it behind square on the leg side for a boundary. India are off to a flier.
Jerome Taylor to share the new ball.
Dhawan gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it. This is the costliest opening over in a T20I for West Indies against India.
FOUR! Another loose delivery down the leg side, Dhawan pounces on it and pulls it powerfully through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Clipped towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Freebie! Short and down the leg side, Dhawan pulls it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Kohli goes back and punches it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! What a way to start! Badree starts with a wrong 'un, but Kohli is ready for it. He camps back and flicks it past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary
The players and the umpires are out in the middle. It's the skipper Virat Kohli opening with the southpaw Shikhar Dhawan. Spin first up as Samuel Badree to start the proceedings with the ball.
India XI - Shikhar Dhawan, Rishabh Pant, Virat Kohli(c), Dinesh Karthik, MS Dhoni(wk), Kedar Jadhav, Ravindra Jadeja, Ravichandran Ashwin, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Kuldeep Yadav, Mohammed Shami.
West Indies XI - Chris Gayle, Evin Lewis, Marlon Samuels, Chadwick Walton(wk), Kieron Pollard, Rovman Powell, Carlos Brathwaite(c), Sunil Narine, Samuel Badree, Jerome Taylor, Kesrick Williams.

Virat Kohli says that he will look to better his toss record and also their records in the T20Is. Mentions that they will back themselves and look to express against the World Champions. States that it is tough to switch for a game but the guys are ready to do it as they all are part of the Indian T20 League. Reckons that it is good to have the same set of guys and adds that the guys have the skillset to perform well.

Carlos Brathwaite says they will bowl first. Feels that they are a better chasing team, so that's what they want to do. States that they don't have the baggage of the ODI series, so can come into this game fresh and head back with a win. When asked about having players like Gayle and Narine in the team, mentions it's a blessing for him as a young captain to try and lead the team successfully and learn from experienced guys like them.
TOSS - West Indies win the toss and opt to bowl. KULDEEP YADAV WILL BE MAKING HIS T20I DEBUT!

Pitch Report - Jeffrey Dujon doing the pitch report says that it is sunny and windy out there. Reckons that this is the same pitch which was used in the first ODI. Mentions that there are some cracks which should help the spinners. Expects the ball to come onto the bat nicely. Ends by saying that there is more moisture and the deck might play similar to the first ODI.

Last time when these two sides met, it was played in U.S.A. which went into the record books for the highest aggregated runs in a single match. It was a thriller which the hosts won by just a run. Let's hope that the weather stays clear and we witness a similar run fest!

The Men from the Caribbean would look to come back strongly in the shortest format of the game, which has proved to be their strength. They have an experienced side in this format with Samuels, Pollard, Narine and Taylor all coming back into the side. Moreover, a major boost has been handed as 'universe boss' Chris Gayle is back in action.

Welcome all of you to the only T20I game between the World T20 champions West Indies and the visitors India at Sabina Park, Jamaica. The Men in Blue won the ODI series 3-1 and would look to repeat a similar performance today as well. They have a good balanced side and would be backing themselves to continue their winning momentum.
